name: maatify/php-paymob
description: PHP SDK for Paymob APIs (Egypt) – reference: https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/ . Supports Auth, Orders, Transactions, and Kiosk payments.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required only for the built-in MySQL/MariaDB token repository (MySqlTokenRepository).
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required only for the built-in MySQL/MariaDB token repository (MySqlTokenRepository).
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required only when selecting the built-in Guzzle HTTP adapter (GuzzleApiClient).
